Create Thrall.name: 创造残骸 Create Thrall
Create Thrall.description:
你在范围内召唤出一具可消耗的不死残骸。若你具有专家死灵术职业特性，你最多可以创造两具残骸；若你具有大师死灵术，则可创造三具；若你具有传奇死灵术，则可创造四具。当你施放此法术时，你可以让本法术创造的至多一具残骸进行一次徒手近战打击，使用你的法术攻击调整值进行攻击掷骰。该攻击造成你选择的 1d6 钝击、穿刺或挥砍伤害。该打击使用并计入你的多重攻击减值。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.ISmLeI8zNc6YWysQ]{Thrall}

升阶（+2） 伤害增加 1d6。

You conjure forth an expendable undead thrall in range. If you have the expert necromancy class feature, you can create up to two thralls, increasing to three if you have master necromancy and four if you have legendary necromancy. When you cast the spell, you can have up to one thrall created by this spell make a melee unarmed Strike using your spell attack modifier for the attack roll. This attack deals your choice of 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. This Strike uses and counts toward your multiple attack penalty.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.ISmLeI8zNc6YWysQ]{Thrall}

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

Bone Spear.name: 骨矛 Bone Spear
Bone Spear.description:
你将一具残骸塑造为一柄锯齿状的骨矛。摧毁你的一具残骸，随后对以该残骸所在处为起点的 15 尺线形内的每个生物进行一次近战法术攻击掷骰对抗其 AC。该骨矛造成 1d8 穿刺伤害（重击时翻倍）。该法术在计算多重攻击减值时视作两次攻击，但在所有攻击结算完毕之前，多重攻击减值不会增加。

升阶（+1） 伤害提升 2d8。

You shape a thrall into a spear of jagged bone. Destroy one of your thralls, then make a melee spell attack roll against the AC of each creature in a 15-foot line from where the thrall was. The spear deals 1d8 piercing damage (or double damage on a critical hit). This spell counts as two attacks toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until you've made all the attacks.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d8.

Muscle Barrier.name: 肌腱之壁 Muscle Barrier
Muscle Barrier.description:
你将一具残骸转化为缠绕于你或一名盟友身上的层层厚实肌肉。该残骸被分割成碎块并被甩向 15 尺内一名自愿生物，摧毁该残骸并赋予该生物 10 临时生命值。该生物在运动检定上获得 +1 状态加值，直到本法术结束。若所有临时生命值都被耗尽，本法术结束。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.mljgz6sVLCA85okJ]{Spell Effect: Muscle Barrier}

升阶（+1） 临时生命值增加 10。

You transform a thrall into layers of thick muscle that wrap around you or an ally. The thrall is split into pieces and flung toward a willing creature within 15 feet of it, destroying the thrall and granting that creature 10 temporary Hit Points. The creature gains a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks until the spell ends. The spell ends if all the temporary Hit Points are gone.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.mljgz6sVLCA85okJ]{Spell Effect: Muscle Barrier}

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 10.

Conglomerate of Limbs.name: 残肢聚合 Conglomerate of Limbs
Conglomerate of Limbs.description:
你召唤出一具体型为超大型的残骸，其拥有 40 生命值。每当一名敌人在与该残骸邻接的位置开始其回合时，其必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，否则被该残骸 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}，持续 1 轮或直到其逃脱。在每个后续轮，每轮一次，你可以维持此法术，使该残骸以其众多肢体拖曳自身在地面上前行，行走至多 15 尺。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.Xuy2zf3qpsmm8wbb]{Conglomerate of Limbs}

升阶（+1） 该残骸的生命值提高 10 点。

You conjure forth a Huge thrall that has 40 Hit Points. Whenever an enemy begins its turn adjacent to this thrall, it must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the thrall for 1 round or until it Escapes. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to have the thrall Stride up to 15 feet, using its many limbs to drag itself across the ground.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.Xuy2zf3qpsmm8wbb]{Conglomerate of Limbs}

Heightened (+1) The thrall's Hit Points increase by 10.

Dead Weight.name: 亡者之重 Dead Weight
Dead Weight.description:
你令一具残骸朝 15 尺内的一名生物扑去，然后以死灵术扭曲该残骸的躯体，使其与该生物融为一体。该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。若该残骸被摧毁，或一名豁免失败的生物成功逃脱，本法术结束。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的速度承受 –10 尺状态减值。

失败 目标陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}。其可以尝试 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}。

大失败 目标被该残骸 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}。其可以尝试逃脱。

You cause a thrall to launch itself at a creature within 15 feet, then necromantically warp the thrall's body to fuse around the creature. The creature must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. This spell ends if the thrall is destroyed or a creature that failed the save successfully Escapes.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the thrall. It can attempt to Escape.

Living Graveyard.name: 活体坟场 Living Graveyard
Living Graveyard.description:
你召唤出一具体型为巨型的残骸，其拥有 400 生命值。该残骸是一座由埋葬死者将其连为一体的、可移动的坟墓与墓碑构成的庞大组合。活体坟场剧烈震荡。10 尺辐射区域内的所有生物都必须成功通过一次强韧豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}。此外，五具残骸（使用基础残骸数据）从墓中跌落至与活体坟场邻接的空位之中。这些额外的残骸持续至本法术结束。

在每个后续轮，每轮一次，你可以维持本法术，使活体坟场行走至多 60 尺，并使另外三具残骸从墓中沿其路径跌落至空位之中。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.CN6TMEeEd0Wmvkct]{Living Graveyard}

You conjure forth a Gargantuan thrall that has 400 Hit Points. This thrall is a walking bulk of graves and tombstones held together by the buried dead. The living graveyard violently shakes. All creatures in a 10-foot emanation must succeed a Fortitude saving throw or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Additionally, five thralls (using the base thrall statistics) fall from their graves into empty spaces adjacent to the living graveyard. These additional thralls last until the spell ends.

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to have the living graveyard Stride up to 60 feet and cause three additional thralls to fall from their graves into empty spaces along its path.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.CN6TMEeEd0Wmvkct]{Living Graveyard}

Flesh Tsunami.name: 血肉海啸 Flesh Tsunami
Flesh Tsunami.description:
你将 30 尺内的一具残骸熔化，将其摧毁并产生一波黏稠的液态血肉，在 60 尺锥形区域中漫流而出。该区域成为更大的困难地形。当你施放血肉海啸时，你可以再液化一具位于该锥形区域内的残骸，使其肢体抓握你的敌人。若你这么做，区域内的每名敌人都必须尝试一次强韧豁免。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 目标的速度承受 –10 尺状态减值，持续 1 轮。

失败 目标的速度承受 –20 尺状态减值，持续 1 轮。

大失败 同失败，且目标 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}，持续 1 轮或直到其逃脱。

You melt one of your thralls within 30 feet, destroying it and creating a wave of sticky, liquid flesh that floods out in a 60-foot cone. The area becomes greater difficult terrain. When you cast flesh tsunami, you can liquefy a second thrall, which must be in the cone's area, to make its limbs grasp your foes. If you do, each enemy in the area must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Failure The target takes a –20-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until it Escapes.

Necrotic Bomb.name: 死灵爆弹 Necrotic Bomb
Necrotic Bomb.description:
你以虚能能量过载你的一具残骸，致使其爆炸。该残骸 10 尺弥漫内的所有生物受到 1d12 虚能伤害，附带一次基础反射豁免。这会摧毁该残骸。

升阶（+1） 伤害提升 1d12。

You overload one of your thralls with void energy, causing it to explode. All creatures within a 10-foot emanation of the thrall take 1d12 void damage with a basic Reflex save. This destroys the thrall.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.

Life Tap.name: 生命分流 Life Tap
Life Tap.description:
你以一具残骸为载体，试图汲取一名生物的精魄并据为己用。该目标残骸行走至多 30 尺，然后由你选择与其邻接的一名生物，该生物必须尝试一次强韧豁免。该目标残骸随后被摧毁。

大成功 目标不受影响。

成功 该生物 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}，但 1 分钟后恢复。你或由你选择的、距该残骸 30 尺内的一名盟友，恢复等同于该生物因陷入流失而失去之生命值的生命值。

失败 同成功，但 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}。

大失败 同成功，但 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}。

Using a thrall as a vessel, you attempt to drain the essence of a creature and use it for yourself. The target thrall Strides up to 30 feet, then one creature of your choice adjacent to it must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. The targeted thrall is then destroyed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, but recovers after 1 minute. You or an ally of your choice within 30 feet of the thrall regain Hit Points equal to the amount the creature lost by becoming drained.

Failure As success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}.

Critical Failure As success, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3}.

Recurring Nightmare.name: 梦魇重现 Recurring Nightmare
Recurring Nightmare.description:
你在范围内召唤一具残骸。与其他残骸不同，该梦魇可以与其他生物共享空间，其他生物也可以轻易地穿过其空间。该残骸若处于空中不会下坠，并且任何会令其行走的能力均改为令其飞行。若该残骸被召唤进入或在飞行中结束于一名生物的空间内，该生物必须成功通过一次意志豁免，否则陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}（或在大失败时陷入 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}）。

在每个后续轮，每轮一次，你可以维持本法术，使该残骸飞行至多 60 尺，或在该残骸已被摧毁时于范围内重新召唤它。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.uu7VA9eIwi1tUZVs]{Recurring Nightmare}

You conjure a thrall within range. Unlike other thralls, the nightmare can share space with other creatures, and other creatures can move through its space with ease. This thrall doesn't fall if in the air, and any ability that would make it Stride makes it Fly instead. If this thrall is summoned into or ends its flight in a creature's space, the creature must succeed a Will saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to have the thrall Fly up to 60 feet or to re-summon the thrall within range if it has been destroyed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.uu7VA9eIwi1tUZVs]{Recurring Nightmare}

Zombie Horde.name: 丧尸大军 Zombie Horde
Zombie Horde.description:
你通过献祭一具残骸来招来一群饥渴的丧尸。所选区域内必须包含你的一具残骸。你的残骸被摧毁。丧尸群所在的区域变为困难地形，每当一名生物在丧尸群中开始自己的回合时，其受到 3d4 钝击伤害，附带一次基础强韧豁免。

在后续轮中，你每轮可以维持一次此法术来将区域移动至多 10 尺。若你将区域移动到一具或多具自己的残骸上方，你可以摧毁其中一具被移动到的残骸，使区域的爆发尺寸增加 5 尺。

升阶（+1） 伤害提升 1d4。

You lure in a horde of ravenous zombies by sacrificing a thrall. The area must contain one of your thralls in it. Your thrall is destroyed. The horde's area is difficult terrain, and whenever a creature begins its turn in the horde, it takes 3d4 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to move the area up to 10 feet. If you move the area onto one or more of your thralls, you can destroy one thrall it moved onto to increase the size of the area's burst by 5 feet.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Perfected Thrall.name: 完化残骸 Perfected Thrall
Perfected Thrall.description:
你创造一具完美的残骸，其由纯粹的肌肉构成，覆有骨质外骨骼，并由一位强大战士的魂灵所栖居。你创造一具拥有 200 生命值的残骸。每当你使用某能力将摧毁该残骸时，其改为损失 20 生命值。

在每个后续轮，每轮一次，你可以维持本法术，使该残骸行走至多 30 尺，并令其使用你的法术攻击调整值对一名邻接的敌人进行打击。命中时，目标受到 7d10 钝击伤害。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.SX5QACMD5SvH9oeZ]{Perfected Thrall}

You create a perfect thrall made of pure muscle, covered in a bony exoskeleton, inhabited by the spirit of a mighty warrior. You create a thrall that has 200 Hit Points. Whenever you use an ability that would destroy this thrall, it instead loses 20 Hit Points.

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to have this thrall Stride up to 30 feet and have it Strike an adjacent enemy using your spell attack modifier. On a hit, the target takes 7d10 bludgeoning damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.SX5QACMD5SvH9oeZ]{Perfected Thrall}

Bony Barrage.name: 白骨弹幕 Bony Barrage
Bony Barrage.description:
你击碎 30 尺内一具残骸的骨骼，将其摧毁，并以该残骸所在位置为起点，于 30 尺锥形内创造出一阵由趾骨、牙齿与椎骨构成的弹幕。区域内的每个生物受到 2d10 穿刺伤害，附带一次基础反射豁免。当你施放白骨弹幕时，你可以击碎位于锥形区域内的第二具残骸，使你的盟友被骨甲覆盖。若你如此做，此锥形不会影响你的盟友，且区域内的任何盟友在 AC 上获得 +1 状态加值，直到你的下回合开始。每具被你击碎的残骸都会被摧毁。

升阶（+1） 伤害提升 1d10。

You shatter the skeleton of a thrall within 30 feet, destroying it and creating a volley of phalanges, teeth, and vertebrae in a 30-foot cone from where the thrall was. Each creature in the area takes 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. When you cast bony barrage, you can shatter a second thrall in the cone's area to cover your allies in bone armor. If you do, the cone doesn't affect your allies, and any ally in the area gains a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. Each thrall you shatter is destroyed.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10.

Skeletal Lancers.name: 骷髅枪阵 Skeletal Lancers
Skeletal Lancers.description:
你在范围内的不同空间中创造五具残骸。这些残骸携带触及范围为 10 尺的骷髅长枪。当一名敌人在某具骷髅枪阵残骸的触及范围内进行打击时，该枪阵对其造成 5 点穿刺伤害。即便该敌人位于多具骷髅枪阵的触及范围内，也只受到一次该伤害。

在每个后续轮，每轮一次，你可以维持本法术，使任意数量的这些残骸行走至多 30 尺。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.d1333zUKqydfJM9b]{Skeletal Lancers}

You create five thralls in different spaces within range. These thralls carry skeletal lances with a reach of 10 feet. When an enemy makes a Strike while in reach of a skeletal lancer thrall, the lancer deals 5 piercing damage to it. The enemy takes this damage only once, even if it's in the reach of multiple skeletal lancers.

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to have any number of these thralls Stride up to 30 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-thralls.Actor.d1333zUKqydfJM9b]{Skeletal Lancers}

Bind Heroic Spirit.name: 束缚英魂 Bind Heroic Spirit
Bind Heroic Spirit.description:
你将一位英雄的魂灵束缚于你的躯体之中。你在攻击掷骰与豁免上获得 +3 状态加值。每当你以打击成功命中一名生物时，在与你目标邻接的空间内创造一具残骸，持续 1 分钟。

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.MTYxqIqJVzza1Lro]{Spell Effect: Bind Heroic Spirit}

You bind the spirit of a hero into your body. You gain a +3 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Whenever you successfully hit a creature with a Strike, create a thrall in a space adjacent to your target that lasts for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-playtest-data.impossible-playtest-effects.Item.MTYxqIqJVzza1Lro]{Spell Effect: Bind Heroic Spirit}
